name: ai-prd-workflow
description: RFC-driven development for AI coding agents: idea or existing codebase → verified PRD → features → rules → sequenced RFCs → reviewed code. Agent Skills for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Devin.

capability_evidence.agent-runtime: - When files disagree, PRD.md wins over FEATURES.md, which wins over RULES.md, then the RFCs.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor

friction.note_en: Easy. install via curl | sh installer; needs git clone (build from source)
friction.note_zh: 较易上手。可通过 curl | sh installer 安装；需要 git clone (build from source)

analysis.summary_en: Idea or existing code → verified PRD → features → rules → sequenced RFCs → reviewed, tested code
highlights: The url-shortener example — fresh-context runs that never saw our list of known problems found 12 of 13 cross-document problems (/workflow-status) and 10 of 10 PRD problems (/verify-prd), p…
Keep the rules in context. Reference RULES.md from your agent config (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or .cursor/rules/). /generate-rules suggests how.
Review with fresh eyes. /review-rfc will not review code written in the same conversation. In Claude Code it runs in a separate context automatically.
analysis.summary_zh_native: 想法或现有代码 → 经过验证的 PRD → 功能 → 规则 → 有序的 RFC → 经过评审和测试的代码
highlights_zh: url-shortener 示例：在全新上下文中运行、从未看过我们问题清单的命令，找出了 13 个跨文档问题中的 12 个（/workflow-status）和 10 个 PRD 问题中的全部 10 个（/verify-prd），还发现了好几个我们漏掉的问题。
用新的眼光评审。 /review-rfc 不会评审在同一个对话中写出的代码；在 Claude Code 中，它会自动在独立的上下文里运行。
先计划，再批准，最后编码。 /implement-rfc 给出计划后会停下来等你。
文件之间有冲突时， PRD.md 优先于 FEATURES.md，其次是 RULES.md，最后是 RFC。
